`event-place.json` is a capture of a Gancio `Event`, kept as captured. It and the Event captures in `../mobilizon/` (`event-banner-nolocation.json`, `group-event-place.json`, `group-event-address-in-name.json`) and `../wordpress/` (`eventbridge-update-event.json`, a WordPress Event Bridge `Update`) come from the Yonder repository (https://git.fabiomanganiello.com/blacklight/yonder), `tests/fixtures/events/`, commit `2eb49a4`, AGPL-3.0 (as Bonfire). Each has a machine-made `summary` (when and where, often the whole description) meant for Mastodon, with the description in `content`.
